request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Add two small round powder kegs on the deck in front of the goblin, painted with bold diagonal black and hazard yellow (#fdd20f) stripes; a short dark fuse sticks out of the front keg, lit with a small bright yellow-white spark. Do not redraw anything else: keep the hull, tin patches, sail, goblin, colours, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with no water, on a transparent background.
